messages:
linda: FYI customer (AcmeApps) reporting SSO failing intermittently after IdP metadata update. They see 403 "RecipientInvalid" on ~30% of auth attempts. Ticket #24567. Logs attached.

tom: can you paste the SAML error / example response? Also which IdP? Okta?

linda: Here's the error block from our production logs:
```
ERROR saml: assertion recipient mismatch: expected https://acme.prod.app/sso/acs but got https://acme.prod.app/sso/acs/
request_id=abc123 tenant=acme
```

linda: IdP is a customer-managed ADFS behind a proxy. They rotated metadata this morning.

raja: hmm trailing slash difference — but our ACS config is normalized. Could be cached metadata picking up duplicate EntityDescriptor with alternate ACS URL. Any metadata dump?

sree: can you fetch the idp metadata used by our metadata-poller? `curl -s http://idp-cache.internal/sources/acme/metadata.xml | xmllint --format -`

linda: grabbed it. There's two <AssertionConsumerService> entries: one with trailing slash and one without. Also a stale <KeyDescriptor> with old cert.

tom: that explains the Recipient check. Our validation chooses first matching ACS in metadata watchlist which is non-deterministic during partial refresh. Pipeline race.

sree: quick workaround: force metadata refresh and prune duplicate ACS entries on our side. I'll open a patch to prefer exact-match ACS and ignore empty-path variants. In the meantime, set poller TTL to 30s for this tenant.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued by @sree at 13:42 UTC — config patch will go to staging, then prod if green :construction:

linda: customer wants a hotfix now. Can we do immediate forced refresh + advisory to their IdP to remove duplicate ACS in published metadata?

tom: I can run a one-off refresh: `POST /admin/metadata/refresh?tenant=acme` — doing it now.

tom: refresh completed. Customer reports auth success rate back to ~99%. Will monitor for 1hr.

raja: follow-up action: (1) implement canonicalization for ACS URLs, (2) add unit test for metadata duplicates, (3) reach out to Acme and ask them to fix metadata publish. I'll own customer comms.

linda: thanks. adding ticket note and closing escalation unless it reappears. :white_check_mark:
